latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Gemini Pet virtual pet system.
- Supports 73+ species with real-time hunger, evolution, and pixel art portraits.
- Includes model-agnostic REST API for pet adoption, care, status checking, and history.
- Features permanent pet death, graveyard, and evolution mechanics.
- Public website and GitHub repository links provided.
